headline: QA-focused morning signals: Playwright test-locks, agentic triage/experiment automation, Kubernetes rootless beta, and CI runner lifecycle visibility

top_signal.title: Playwright v1.63.0 — named Test locks to serialize access to shared resources
top_signal.summary: Playwright 1.63 adds named `lock` support so tests that touch a shared resource never run concurrently across files, workers and projects, while other tests remain parallel.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Makes it easier to eliminate flakiness from shared-resource tests without sacrificing parallelism — simplifies test design, CI runner configuration, and resource isolation strategies.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37 — KubeletInUserNamespace (rootless) graduates to Beta
items.summary: Kubernetes 1.37 promotes KubeletInUserNamespace (rootless) to Beta, enabling node components to run in a non-root user namespace on hosts.
items.why_it_matters: Enables safer, non-privileged test runners and local CI agents, reducing need for privileged containers and improving test environment parity and isolation.

items.title: Investigate DMS migration issues with AWS DevOps Agent
items.summary: AWS shows how to extend AWS DevOps Agent to autonomously investigate and triage Database Migration Service migration problems using read-only tools, runbooks and evidence collection.
items.why_it_matters: QA teams can automate pre-cutover readiness checks and post-cutover triage, reducing manual investigation time and preserving reproducible evidence for failures.

items.title: Automating the experimentation lifecycle with Kiro, AWS DevOps Agent, and LaunchDarkly
items.summary: Demonstrates an end-to-end Plan→Prove→Iterate flow where Kiro and AWS DevOps Agent orchestrate feature-flagged experiments, guarded rollouts and PR creation via LaunchDarkly.
items.why_it_matters: Provides a blueprint for embedding automated experiment validation and quality checks into release pipelines, reducing manual gating and improving repeatable experiment testing.

items.title: GitHub Actions: new REST API for runner deprecations, vulnerability-alerts permission, and job context properties
items.summary: GitHub Actions added a REST API to query when runner versions stop being supported, plus a `vulnerability-alerts` GITHUB_TOKEN permission and new `job` context properties for reusable workflows.
items.why_it_matters: Test-infra owners can proactively plan runner upgrades to avoid broken test agents; new permissions and job context values help lock down and trace test workflows.

watch.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models (effective Oct 2, 2026)
watch.summary: GitHub announced several Copilot models will be deprecated across Copilot Chat, inline edits and agent modes on October 2, 2026.
watch.why_it_matters: Teams using Copilot-based test-generation or agentic QA workflows must validate replacements and update agent configurations before Oct 2 to avoid disruptions.

learning.title: AWS DevOps Agent — User Guide (comprehensive agent documentation)
learning.summary: AWS published a 520-page user guide covering agent concepts (skills, memories), MCP integrations, webhooks, sample skills, onboarding and troubleshooting for AWS DevOps Agent.
learning.why_it_matters: Practical reference for QA engineers building agent-driven test investigators, triage skills, and experiment orchestration using AWS DevOps Agent.
